# `MC_grpFlushLcd`

Flush a rectangular frame-buffer region to a display.

## Prototype

```c
void MC_grpFlushLcd(M_Int32 i, MC_GrpFrameBuffer frm, M_Int32 x, M_Int32 y, M_Int32 w, M_Int32 h);
```
